annotations.title: Technical indicators: RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, stochastic, SMA/EMA from your prices

description: Technical indicators: RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, stochastic, SMA/EMA from your prices — Offline technical analysis of a price series you supply (stocks, crypto, FX). prices= (required) comma-separated closes, oldest first, 15-5000 values. Optional: high= and low= (same length, enables true-range ATR and stochastic), volume= (on-balance volume), sma=20,50,200 and ema=12,26 periods, rsi=14, bb=20, bb_k=2, atr=14, stoch=14, tail=N (last N rows of RSI/EMA series). Returns Wilder RSI with zone, MACD 12/26/9 with recent bullish/bearish crosses, Bollinger %B/bandwidth/squeeze, ATR % of price, stochastic %K/%D, OBV trend, rate of change, 52-week style range, golden/death cross, a signal list and an overall bias STRONG_BULLISH..STRONG_BEARISH. Descriptive, not investment advice. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_technical_indicators
